title: NBA Daily Digest
subtitle: Friday, October 30, 2026 – Early Season Action & NBA Cup Tips Off!

items.headline: Emirates NBA Cup Group Play Commences Today!
items.summary: The highly anticipated fourth edition of the Emirates NBA Cup tips off today, October 30, 2026, with a slate of 10 games marking the start of group play. All 30 NBA teams will compete in the tournament, culminating in the championship game on December 11 at Hinkle Fieldhouse in Indianapolis.

items.headline: Ja Morant Exits Grizzlies Game with Hamstring Injury
items.summary: Portland Trail Blazers guard Ja Morant left Thursday night's game against his former team, the Memphis Grizzlies, in the fourth quarter due to a left hamstring injury. He recorded 14 points and three assists in 23 minutes before exiting the 124-103 loss.

items.headline: Hawks Hold Off Cavaliers in Tight Contest
items.summary: The Atlanta Hawks secured a 114-111 victory over the Cleveland Cavaliers. Onyeka Okongwu led the Hawks with a season-high 29 points and 12 rebounds.

items.headline: Pelicans Outscore Kings in High-Flying Affair
items.summary: The New Orleans Pelicans defeated the Sacramento Kings 132-120. Jeremiah Fears starred for the Pelicans with 22 points, a career-high 13 assists, and 8 rebounds, while Zion Williamson added 22 points. For the Kings, rookie Darius Acuff Jr. posted an impressive 34 points and 12 assists.

items.headline: Boozer's Triple-Double Leads Undefeated Grizzlies Past Blazers
items.summary: The Memphis Grizzlies remained unbeaten, topping the Portland Trail Blazers 124-103. Rookie Cameron Boozer recorded his first career triple-double with 18 points, 12 rebounds, and 12 assists. Deni Avdija paced the Blazers with 24 points, 9 rebounds, and 7 assists before Ja Morant exited with an injury.

items.headline: Rookie Cameron Boozer Delivers First Career Triple-Double
items.summary: Memphis Grizzlies rookie Cameron Boozer stuffed the stat sheet with 18 points, 12 rebounds, and 12 assists, achieving his first career triple-double in a 124-103 victory over the Portland Trail Blazers.

items.headline: Deni Avdija Continues Strong Start to Season
items.summary: Deni Avdija showcased his all-around game for the Portland Trail Blazers, tallying 24 points, 9 rebounds, and 7 assists against the Memphis Grizzlies. This follows a 23-point, 9-assist effort against the Lakers and a 26-point outing against the Kings.

items.headline: Darius Acuff Jr. Explodes for Career-High 34 Points
items.summary: Sacramento Kings rookie Darius Acuff Jr. lit up the scoreboard with a career-high 34 points and added 12 assists in a losing effort against the New Orleans Pelicans.

sections.title: Around the League: Today's NBA Cup Slate

items.headline: Knicks vs. 76ers Headlines Emirates NBA Cup Opener
items.summary: The defending champion New York Knicks face the Philadelphia 76ers at 7:30 PM ET on Prime Video, kicking off their Emirates NBA Cup group play campaign. This highly anticipated matchup features LeBron James in a 76ers jersey.

items.headline: Lakers and Warriors Clash in Prime Video Doubleheader
items.summary: In a Western Conference Emirates NBA Cup battle, the Los Angeles Lakers visit the Golden State Warriors at 10:00 PM ET on Prime Video. This is a rematch of the season opener.

items.headline: Heat Host Pacers in Emirates NBA Cup Group Play
items.summary: The Miami Heat, featuring Giannis Antetokounmpo who is averaging 27.6 points and 11.2 rebounds through five games, take on an injury-riddled Indiana Pacers squad at 8:00 PM ET. The Pacers will be without Tyrese Haliburton, who is sidelined with a hamstring strain.

items.headline: Surprising Pistons Visit Struggling Nets
items.summary: The Detroit Pistons, off to a strong 4-1 start, travel to face the Brooklyn Nets, who are still searching for their first win at 0-4. The game tips off at 7:30 PM ET.
